links.outcome: Proportion of retina cases correctly diagnosed by custom GPT-4 chatbot using multimodal images
links.effect: Correct diagnosis in 35 of 69 cases (50.7%); needed full patient description for 23 of 35 correct cases (65.7%); OR 10.1 (95% CI 3.3-30.3) for full description vs age and sex only.
links.quote: The diagnostic ability of the chatbot in interpretation of multimodal imaging without text-based information is currently limited.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of GPT-4 on multimodal retinal teaching cases with varying amounts of clinical text context, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
